project_context.theme: Light theme primary with Swiss & High-Contrast archetype
project_context.core_purpose: Audio to text transcription, optimized for low quality / low frequency audio files.

typography.guidelines: Use Cabinet Grotesk for headlines to give a strong, authoritative feel. Use IBM Plex Sans for long transcribed text to ensure high legibility. Use IBM Plex Mono for file sizes, supported formats, and progress stats.

colors.guidelines: Strictly stick to monochrome + one vibrant accent (Klein Blue) for active states like the progress bar. Use Accent Red only for error handling (unsupported files).

layouts.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 for component separation.
layouts.alignment: Center the main upload container, but left-align all transcribed text and internal text blocks for readability.

Header.style: Solid background bg-[#FAFAFA] with a hard 1px bottom border border-black/10.
Header.content: App Logo/Title (e.g., 'SesDeşifre') and a badge saying 'Düşük Frekans Optimizasyonu'

Dropzone.style: Grid Borders strategy. border-2 border-dashed border-black/20 rounded-none bg-white p-12 text-center hover:bg-black/5 hover:border-black transition-all cursor-pointer
elements: Title: 'Ses dosyasını buraya sürükleyin veya seçmek için tıklayın'
Subtitle: 'Desteklenen formatlar: mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, webm'

ProgressIndicator.style: Technical look. h-2 w-full bg-black/10 rounded-none overflow-hidden
ProgressIndicator.text: Monospace text for percentage. Label: 'Ses işleniyor (Gürültü azaltma ve düşük frekans iyileştirme aktif)...'

TranscriptionResult.text_area: leading-relaxed text-gray-800 max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar text-left
TranscriptionResult.actions_bar: flex justify-end gap-4 mt-6 border-t border-black/10 pt-4

Buttons.primary: bg-black text-white px-6 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2
Buttons.secondary: border border-black text-black px-6 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2

motion.guidelines: Use framer-motion for LayoutGroup to smoothly animate the container expanding when moving from Upload -> Progress -> Result states. Stagger the appearance of transcribed text lines if simulating the effect.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise texture over the background (bg-opacity 2%) to give an 'analog audio' feel without sacrificing clean design.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (UploadCloud, FileAudio, Copy, Download, AlertCircle).

accessibility.guidelines: All text must pass WCAG AA contrast against background. Dropzone must be keyboard focusable (tabindex=0) with visible focus ring. Use aria-live='polite' for the transcription text appearing.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React files, NOT .tsx. Provide vanilla JS or PropTypes, no TypeScript types.
The UI MUST be entirely in Turkish as per the user's request.
Ensure the app feels like a high-end Swiss-designed forensic audio tool. The 'low quality' audio processing should be communicated via technical UI badges (e.g., 'Gelişmiş Filtre: Aktif').
Use framer-motion to create seamless state transitions (Initial -> Uploading/Processing -> Complete).
Implement file validation logic: reject non-audio files immediately and show an error toast.
Use the 'sonner' library for toast notifications (e.g., 'Panoya kopyalandı', 'Desteklenmeyen dosya formatı').
Add 'data-testid' attributes to key elements: data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='copy-btn', data-testid='download-btn', data-testid='transcription-text'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply generic centered layouts for text; left-align paragraphs.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Do not use transparent background on surfaces that overlap other content.
